passes.reasoning: Claim 2: E03 compares ts_online with the label-free agreement threshold at an equal 545-group budget. The baseline has no free labels. D = -0.172, CI [-0.230, -0.142], so it favors the fixed rule. L5a and L5c (shipped class) agree, with CIs entirely below 0. Claim 3: E10 (OLMo-2, a different model than E01) has AUC gain -0.002 and cell100 neighbor ratio 0.998. E04 and L7b (judge proxies) show the same: gain 0.0001 and -0.006, ratio 1.00. All are below the 0.05 and 1.5 thresholds, so the kill rule fires. The free-label confound was controlled by the label-free threshold arm, so W2 is false. No entry's standing conclusion says claim 3 is supported, so W3 is false.

W2 false: the confound is controlled because the baseline is label-free. W3 false: no entry holds claim 3 as supported.
